reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically sound, linking lattice distortion (MSAD) to solid-solution strength, dislocation inertia at cryogenic temperatures, and dynamic strain aging (PLC effect) at high temperatures, all well-established mechanisms in FCC alloys.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis is highly testable with a clear, multi-pronged experimental plan (CRSS vs. T, strain-rate jumps, TEM, DFT) and explicit falsification criteria, though the falsification statement is somewhat generic.
reasons.usefulness: This is a very useful, mechanistic hypothesis that directly addresses the research question by proposing specific, testable mechanisms (MSAD, inertia, PLC) to explain property differences beyond constituent count, guiding targeted experiments.
